| Rank | Cause | Cheap test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | state/session.json saved by the last run | move it aside, relaunch |
| 2 | state/cache/index.json | move it aside, relaunch |

fail.answer: The likeliest cause is a bug in _load: it raises on any OSError. Second, the lock file may be stale.
Suspects: the session, the cache, the settings and the lock file. One of them is probably corrupt.
